items.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort is whisking us back to Wuhu Island later this year, for boxing, bowling, skateboarding and more
items.description:
Wuhu Island is calling once more: Nintendo has revealed it'll be taking us back to its well-travelled retreat for a spot of Joy-Con-powered action when Nintendo Switch Sports Resort comes to Switch 2 on 22nd October.

items.title: We're getting our first HD-2D Final Fantasy game, and it's based on the now-shuttered mobile title Brave Exvius
items.description:
Today, as part of the June 2026 Nintendo Direct, Square Enix revealed that we'll be getting our first HD-2D Final Fantasy game later this year. Named Final Fantasy Resonance, the title arrives 22nd October on PlayStation, Xbox, PC, and Nintendo Swtich 1/2.

Read more

items.title: Xbox's chief strategy officer says it's currently hard to meet console demand and suggests Microsoft is rethinking Project Helix approach
items.description:
Following a solid Xbox Games Showcase when it came to the brand's software lineup, players continue to have questions about the brand's larger strategy - especially pertaining exclusives - and whether Project Helix can realistically release in the near future amid component shortages.

items.description:

items.description:
It's two for two on the Nintendo rumours front. After whispers of a Star Fox remake turned out to be true, the company has confirmed it's also got a The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on the way, and it's coming to Switch 2 later this year.

items.title: Minecraft is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 this year

Minecraft is coming to the Nintendo Switch 2 later this year, with no specific release date announced.

items.title: FromSoftware's The Duskbloods still doesn't have a release date, but there's a Switch 2 playtest coming soon
items.description:
It's been over a year since we first got a look at Elden Ring developer FromSoftware's fascinatingly weird multiplayer adventure The Duskbloods, but finally - after its publisher stepped in to offer assurances that it's still out this year - it's reappeared. There's still no release date, mind, with its latest showing merely confirming a closed playtest is coming to Switch 2 this "summer".

items.title: Xenoblade Genesis announced during Nintendo Direct, coming in 2027 to the Nintendo Switch 2
items.description:
Xenoblade Genesis has been revealed at today's Nintendo Direct. It's coming in 2027 to the Nintendo Switch 2, with a specific release date or window not announced quite yet.

Well, that's me back in. Just when I thought my time with Pokémon Pokopia might be coming to an end, Nintendo has unveiled a whole bunch of new stuff launching this August.

items.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave crams itself into an already packed-out September 2026 on Switch 2
items.description:
I hope your wallet and social lives are ready, because September 2026 is looking like an absolute disaster for game releases. Today, at a Nintendo Direct, the publisher finally announced a release date Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. The game arrives 17th September, 2026 and will be arriving exclusively on Switch 2. Nintendo also announced there will be a physical edition including some bonus items releasing on the same day.

items.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword is slashing its way to the Nintendo Switch 2
items.description:
Onimusha: Way of the Sword has been announced for the Nintendo Switch 2. You can pre-order it now, with the game releasing on the 25th September.

Read more

items.title: Sony Pictures' Helldivers movie has lost Jason Momoa as its lead, just months after announcing the star's involvement
items.description:
Sony Pictures and PlayStation Productions have been moving relatively fast on the Helldivers movie adaptation announced back in January 2025, securing Fast & Furious veteran Justin Lin to direct and, earlier this year, Jason Momoa (Aquaman, A Minecraft Movie) to star. Now, we're hearing the latter has departed the project.

Read more

items.title: "It's a choice" - A Plague Tale developer Asobo doesn't believe smaller teams need to use gen-AI to compete
items.description:
French developer Asobo, creator of the Plague Tale series and the Microsoft Flight Simulator games, doesn't believe smaller teams need to use generative AI tools to compete with bigger development studios.

Read more

items.title: Following generative AI controversy, Crazy Taxi: World Tour lead clarifies how the tech is being used
items.description:
Crazy Taxi: World Tour's reveal during the Xbox Games Showcase was a highlight, finally offering a look at the modern incarnation of the classic series. The excitement was quickly soured, however, when its Steam page revealed Sega has used generative AI in the game's development.

Read more

items.title: Mina the Hollower sells 500k copies less than two weeks after launch as Yacht Club Games teases "the adventure is just getting started"
items.description:
Shovel Knight studio Yacht Club Games was worried last year about Mina the Hollower's launch after such a long time away from the public, but it turns out it had nothing to worry about. Mina's debut has now sold over 500k copies in less than two weeks.

Read more

items.title: Game Pass lost millions of subscribers as a result of last year's controversial price hike, Xbox chief strategy officer reveals
items.description:
Xbox Game Pass lost millions of subscribers following the fall 2025 price hike, Xbox's chief strategy officer Matthew Ball has revealed.

items.title: Final Fantasy 10/10-2 HD Remaster gets a dedicated Switch 2 port next month, but there's a catch
items.description:
Later today, we're getting a pretty big Nintendo Direct, but ahead of the showcase going live Square Enix has decided to treat us to something a little early: a trailer for a Switch 2 version of the Final Fantasy 10/10-2 HD Remaster.

Read more

items.title: Sea of Stars: Sunset Edition is the hit retro-inspired RPG's final update, but it "sets the stage for the adventure to come"
items.description:
Sabotage Studio has revealed it's planning to move on from Sea of Stars after nearly three years of post-launch support which has included substantial free content updates. But don't worry; there's life beyond this Sunset Edition patch.

Read more

items.title: Nintendo Direct live report - all the news and announcements from the summer 2026 show
items.description:
We're not done yet. This afternoon, at the very agreeable time of 3pm UK, Nintendo will broadcast a Direct showcase showing us what it's got for Switch and Switch 2 in the weeks and months ahead. And we'll be covering all of the news and announcements live, as they happen, right here in this article.

items.title: Official Gears of War: E-Day video gets taken down for including a PS5 logo, adding more fuel to the last-minute change theory
items.description:
It's been an eventful few days for Xbox. Gears of War: E-Day was officially confirmed during the Xbox Games Showcase to be a console exclusive, hours after a PEGI rating for the PS5 version surfaced.

items.title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Eternal Whispers is a narrative-driven CRPG channelling Disco Elysium
items.description:
Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 was a considerable disappointment, but that isn't stopping the IP's video game efforts in their tracks. In fact, Eternal Whispers - a new CRPG taking more than a few cues from Disco Elysium - might be the balm we need.

Read more

items.title: Microsoft's next big release Halo: Campaign Evolved just got a slick story trailer, with footage captured on PS5 Pro
items.description:
Halo: Campaign Evolved, one of Microsoft's next big triple-A releases, just got a cool-looking cinematic story trailer. And all footage you'll see in it has been captured on a PS5 Pro, of course.

Read more

items.title: State of Decay 3 dev wanted the first gameplay trailer to show off how much higher the game's quality is, but promises deeper systems are still there
items.description:
State of Decay 3 was among the few surprising reveals during the Xbox Games Showcase. We've been waiting years to hear, or see, well, anything from the zombie survival management sim since the moment it was initially announced - which was nearly six years ago.

Read more

items.title: Doom: The Dark Ages expanding with Revelations DLC in July, plus a free Ripatorium update adding to the game's customisable arena mode
items.description:
Doom: The Dark Ages was a fun time, but we'd been wondering about the release window for its DLC (and its very nature) since a Premium Edition was released day one. During the Xbox Games Showcase, Bethesda Softworks and id Software finally unveiled the Revelations DLC.

Read more

items.title: Nintendo Direct announced for tomorrow
items.description:
If you thought we were done with the showcases, think again, as Nintendo has just announced a Direct. This Direct will air tomorrow, 9th June, at 3pm UK time.

Read more
category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

items.title: Guild Wars 3 will have no battle pass or subscription because ArenaNet studio lead doesn't want to "keep people hostage"
items.description:
Guild Wars 3 will feature no mandatory subscription or premium battlepass, and will be buyable as a premium product like previous games in the series.

Read more

items.title: Arkane Lyon's Blade game isn't dead, despite rumours following Xbox Games Showcase no-show
items.description:
UPDATE 2.38pm: Arkane's Blade project has not been cancelled.

Read more

items.title: Monster Hunter: World has now sold over 30m units worldwide, becoming Capcom's "best-selling single title of all time"
items.description:
Monster Hunter Wilds' much-anticipated expansion-sized DLC, titled Ascendance, is coming next year. But with lots of performance woes and a long wait for meaty endgame battles, we aren't surprised the game always struggled to live up to the heights of Monster Hunter: World, a game which has been blessed with enduring popularity. Now, Capcom has revealed 2018's instalment has crossed an important milestone.

Read more

items.title: Yes, Gears of War: E-Day is bringing back Horde and Versus, even if they were barely mentioned
items.description:
As promised, Gears of War: E-Day developer The Coalition followed up the Xbox Games Showcase with a presentation entirely dedicated to the upcoming third-person shooter. The nearly 28-minute-long Direct expanded on the gameplay demo we saw at the Showcase, revealing more details about the core design philosophy, as well as the modes we can expect at launch.

Read more

items.title: "Maybe AI could create art, but while I live, I don't think I'll see it" - weeks after starring in a Prada art promotion created with AI tools, Hideo Kojima seems to dismiss the controversial tech's creative abilities
items.description:
Cast your minds back to last month, and you will recall a rather bizarre video featuring Death Stranding creator Hideo Kojima travelling through space and crashing on a hostile planet. This wasn't a promotion for a new game, rather it was a collaboration with filmmaker Nicolas Winding Refn and fashion house Prada for an art installation. Oh, the short film - known as Satellites II - was made with the help of AI tools, which you won't be surprised to hear ruffled more than a few feathers.

Read more

items.title: Carcass Clad, the Mouthwashing team's next game, is a horrifying co-op tank game, announced at the PC Gaming Show
items.description:
The developers of Mouthwashing - the sci-fi horror hit - have announced their next game: Carcass Clad.

Read more

items.title: Cassette Beasts 2002 is the sequel to 2023's monster-collecting RPG, and it's coming to PC and consoles with multiplayer from the get-go
items.description:
Many indie studios have tried to replicate Pokémon's formula, but few have actually cracked the code. In 2023, Bytten Studio got it right with Cassette Beasts, mainly because it had something to add to the mix and wasn't entirely built on nostalgia. Now, the developers aim to take it to the next level with Cassette Beasts 2002.

Read more

items.title: Surprising no one, Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra won't be out this year
items.description:
Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra, a game that genuinely only seems to come up when it's getting delayed, has been… delayed yet again. That's according to Paramount Games Studio boss, who revealed that the ambitious game is playable, but won't be out for some time.

Read more

items.title: Xbox seeks to clarify its approach to console exclusive games, after last night's PS5 snub for Gears of War: E-Day and Clockwork Revolution caught many off guard
items.description:
Xbox has shed more light on the company's exclusivity strategy, after last night's showcase threw a few surprises our way.

Read more

items.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie crosses $1bn worldwide, but its predecessor still retains the video game adaptation crown
items.description:
Despite making the jump to video-on-demand on digital platforms last month, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is still holding its theatrical position in cinemas in some locations. Now, it's finally pushed its global box office haul past the $1bn mark.

Read more

items.title: Fable is getting some post-launch DLC already, with an extended look at gameplay planned for later this week
items.description:
Playground Games has announced some post-launch DLC for Fable, months out from its release date in February of next year.

items.title: After over five years in early access, Valheim is finally graduating to version 1.0
items.description:
Viking survival and crafting hit, Valheim, which first appeared in early access in early 2021, is almost ready for its full release. Developer Iron Gate announced at the PC Gaming Show that the game will officially launch on 9th September.

items.title: Citizen Sleeper creator's new game is a "fungalpunk" RPG in which you're a parasite, infecting the lives of people in a city inspired by post-punk Britain
items.description:
Citizen Sleeper creator Gareth Damian Martin's new game is something quite different: a first-person "fungalpunk" narrative role-playing game inspired by post-punk Britain, in which you play as a literal parasite, infecting and navigating the lives of people in Signet City.

Read more

items.title: Stealth classic Thief: The Dark Project is getting the remaster treatment from retro specialist Nightdive Studios
items.description:
Retro specialist Nightdive is at it again. After successfully tackling System Shock and its sequel (giving them the remake and remaster treatment respectively), Nightdive is once again returning to the world of legendary developer Looking Glass Studios and sprucing up another of its beloved early immersive sims. Yup, it's time to retreat to the shadows as we await the launch of Thief: The Dark Project Remastered on PC and consoles.

Read more

items.title: Xbox's Gears of War: E-Day and Clockwork Revolution are not timed exclusives, as PlayStation 5 misses out on upcoming releases
items.description:
We just got another look at Gears of War: E-Day and Clockwork Revolution at this evening's Xbox Games Showcase. While many had assumed that Gears of War: E-Day specifically would be coming to PlayStation 5 as well as part of Xbox's recent drive to release its game across multiple platforms, that is not the case.

Read more

items.title: Crazy Taxi World Tour officially announced, Sega immediately upsets everyone by announcing it used generative AI
items.description:
It's been a rollercoaster day for Crazy Taxi. Today, at Xbox's showcase, we saw the first trailer for the long-teased rebooted game in the series. In a new trailer (below) Sega announced that the game is set to launch on Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Windows PC, and Xbox Series X in 2027.

Read more

items.title: Xbox unveils retro-inspired console and controller to celebrate its 25th anniversary, and they're launching this November
items.description:
It's Xbox's 25th birthday this year, don't you know, and Microsoft is celebrating in a multitude of ways. It's made its logo transparent, for starters, and it's decided to go all-caps. But if that's still not enough to be getting on with, the company has now revealed a special transparent green Xbox Series X and controller that'll be available to purchase this November.

Read more

We're getting a third Hellblade game except it's not called Hellblade 3 because it's a different thing to what's come before. Senua, as it's simply known, is a full-fat action-adventure, with more exploration, more puzzles, and deeper combat.

items.title: Metro 2039 goes to war with the underground's Führer in a moody first gameplay trailer, as February 2027 release window confirmed
items.description:
Following Metro 2039's striking cinematic unveiling back in April, developer 4A Games has revealed first proper gameplay of its gritty post-apocalyptic horror shooter, narrowing down its previously announced "winter" release date to February next year.

items.description:

items.description:
Well here's something that wasn't on my Summer Game Fest bingo card. Bloober Team, the studio behind the likes of Observer and 2024's sublime Silent Hill 2 remake, has unveiled its latest foray into the dread world of horror: a Star Trek game coming next year.

items.title: Monster Hunter Wilds confirmed for Nintendo Switch 2
items.description:
Remember those rumours of a Nintendo Switch 2 port of Monster Hunter Wilds that wouldn't quite go away? Dataminers believed they've discovered evidence that Monster Hunter Wilds could be coming to Nintendo Switch 2 at the start of the year – and then again in February – and now it seems they were right: Monster Hunter Wilds is indeed coming to Nintendo Switch 2.

items.title: Studio behind Martha is Dead, the game too extreme for PlayStation, debuts gameplay from its psychological serial killer horror When Sirens Fall Silent
items.description:
LKA, the studio behind 2016's acclaimed The Town of Light and its controversial 2024 follow-up Martha is Dead, has shared first gameplay of its next project. When Sirens Fall Silent is a psychological serial killer horror and it's coming to PC next year.

items.title: Acclaimed co-op series Trine is returning for a fresh adventure with new and familiar faces, and a heist that goes wrong
items.description:
If your life's been lacking a bit of colour lately, have no fear: developer Frozenbyte's acclaimed co-op platforming series Trine is back for a sixth outing, and once again it's the aesthetic equivalent of a Dulux catalogue. It's not too far off release either. Trine 6: Together in Time, in all its kaleidoscopic glory, comes to PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, and PC on 17th September.

Read more

items.title: Yooka-Laylee is back in a SNES-style kart racer from some of the team behind Diddy Kong Racing
items.description:
It's somehow been seven years since Yooka-Laylee's last proper adventure (I'm not sure 2025's remake, as enjoyable as it was, entirely counts), but the bat and lizard duo are finally back, and this time in a brand-new form. Yes, those recent leaks were right: we're in for some classic SNES-style kart racing action when the now-officially announced Super Yooka-Laylee Kart arrives for PC at some currently undisclosed future time.

Read more

items.title: IO Interactive's James Bond game 007 First Light sells 2.7 million copies in its first week, as dev reiterates free Year One content
items.description:
007 First Light is already racking up some pretty impressive sales figures for IO Interactive. Today, in a presentation given to the press after the Summer Game Fest 2026 showcase, IO studio director Hakan Abrak told Eurogamer that the game sold 2.7 million copies in its first week on sale - and is now 'closer to 3 million copies sold'.

items.title: Aion 2's global release date announced at Summer Game Fest
items.description:
Aion 2 - the sequel to legendary Korean MMORPG Aion - has had its global release date revealed at Summer Game Fest.

items.title: The Wolf Among Us 2 finally arrives next year, a decade after it was announced, but a remaster of the acclaimed original is coming first
items.description:
It's finally happening, apparently. After a protracted and extremely tumultuous decade of development, The Wolf Among Us 2 is supposedly now launching next year. And there's a remaster of the much-loved original on the way to tide us over until then.

items.title: Monster Hunter Ascendance is to Wilds what Iceborne was to Monster Hunter World, coming 2027
items.description:
Monster Hunter Wilds' first expansion, Ascendance, has finally been revealed. In a trailer at Summer Games Fest 2026, Capcom unveiled the future of the game with a massive new expansion called Ascendance.

items.title: Maverick Games reveals Clutch, an open-world racer set in the rather gorgeous-looking French Riviera

Clutch - the cinematic, open-world, action-driving game from the team at Maverick Games, and which is being headed up by former Forza Horizon creative director Mike Brown - just got itself a very slick new trailer at this evening's Summer Game Fest, showing of its rather lovely rendition of Monaco and the French Riviera.

items.title: Final Fantasy 7 Remake Part 3 is called Revelation, coming to PS5, Xbox and Switch 2 simultaneously Spring 2027

Square Enix has finally announced, as part of today's Summer Games Fest showcase, some more information about the third instalment of Final Fantasy 7 Remake series. It's called Final Fantasy 7 Revelation

items.description:

And now it's Saw turn to try its luck where others have failed in the newly announced Saw: Genesis, which is on the way courtesy of Silent Hill 2 developer Bloober Team.

items.title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush announced at Summer Game Fest, launching later this year

Hot Wheels Infinite Rush has just been announced at Summer Game Fest.

At this evening's Summer Game Fest showcase, Panache Digital Games and Patrice Désilets gave us all a trailer for 1666: Amsterdam.

items.description:

Crossfire was revealed today during Summer Game Fest's opening ceremony. This is the debut title from That's No Moon, an independent studio featuring key talent behind the 2019 Modern Warfare reboot's campaign, and Naughty Dog before that.

items.title: Here's our best look yet at Alien: Isolation 2 as one of the greatest horror games ever prepares to return
items.description:
On Alien: Isolation's 10th anniversary a couple of years ago, director Al Hope shared some exciting news: a very long-awaited sequel was finally in development. Beyond that, we learned little else. Earlier this year, however, we got our first teaser trailer, and today, during Summer Game Fest's big showcase extravaganza, we've had our best look yet at Alien: Isolation 2.

Read more

items.title: Three years later, that 'dark' Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin game gets a first trailer, and it's being created by Bayonetta studio Platinum Games
items.description:
Some three years after it was announced an unnamed developer was taking the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles in a darker video game direction with a project inspired by the well-regarded TMNT graphic novel The Last Ronin, the game has finally - albeit vaguely - been unveiled. And it turns out the mysterious team behind it is none other than famed Bayonetta, Nier: Automata, and Ninja Gaiden 4 developer Platinum Games.

Read more

items.title: Cuphead 2 in the works at Studio MDHR, as well as a new arcade shooter based on the series
items.description:
A new hand-animated Cuphead game is in development from Studio MDHR. The news was shared with a short segment during this evening's Summer Game Fest showcase. This upcoming game will take Cuphead's characters on a "fresh, exciting adventure".

Read more

items.title: Fumito Ueda, legendary developer behind Shadow of the Colossus and Ico, announces single-player epic Gen Atlas for Xbox, PlayStation, and PC
items.description:
Fumito Ueda, the creator of Ico, Shadow of the Colossus and The Last Guardian, revealed his next sci-fi project at tonight's Summer Game Fest - the first big information drop we've seen about the game since its reveal back at The Game Awards 2024.

Read more

items.title: Resident Evil: Code Veronica Remake announced at Summer Game Fest, coming in 2027
items.description:
Resident Evil: Veronica has been announced at Summer Game Fest. The game will release in 2027 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

Read more

items.title: Buffy the Vampire Slayer and Ted Lasso star Anthony Head dies aged 72
items.description:
British actor Anthony Head, known widely for his portrayal of Giles in the Buffy the Vampire Slayer, has died from complications due to pneumonia, aged 72 years old.

Read more

items.title: Xbox boss Asha Sharma still can't seem to decide on a stance regarding console exclusivity
items.description:
Newly-appointed Xbox CEO, Asha Sharma, has now spent over 100 days in her new role. Speaking recently at Bloomberg Tech Live, the executive was asked yet again about the company's stance on exclusivity for first-party games, and whether or not this can even be managed when Microsoft is also one of the largest third-party publishers in the world.

Read more

items.title: Marathon Deluxe Edition discount offers free-trial players bonuses without the full game, confusion ensues
items.description:
Some confusion around Marathon's Deluxe edition appears to be popping up, as a discounted deluxe edition version of the game bought by many PlayStation users does not actually include the full game.

items.title: "We are seeing a certain degree of effectiveness from the use of generative AI" - Capcom clarifies its stance on using the controversial tech
items.description:
Capcom has said why it is using generative AI in its business, stating its policy is "to improve the efficiency of routine operations so that our developers can devote more time to essential value creation".

items.title: Summer Game Fest 2026 live report - all the news and announcements from Geoff Keighley's big night
items.description:
The centre-piece show of Summer Game Fest - the literal Summer Game Fest showcase - takes place tonight at 10pm UK time (11pm CEST / 5pm EDT / 2pm PDT), and we'll be covering all the news and announcements from it, live, right here in this article. There may be a pre-show; it's unconfirmed.

items.title: June's PlayStation State of Play breaks records, is reportedly the most-watched ever
items.description:
Sony has successfully made its State of Play showcase series into a brand that brings in millions of views with each episode. The most recent showcase, which took place 2nd June ahead of Summer Game Fest 2026, was apparently its biggest-ever, no matter which way you measure it.

Read more

items.title: Yet another new Crimson Desert update is here, and this one adding Pinball, because of course
items.description:
Pearl Abyss is on quite the Crimson Desert patch roll, and has just released another update for its popular single player RPG spin-off from hit Korean MMO Black Desert. Just last week, the developer added the ability to remap your controller, and now it is gone and added new minigames and more.

Read more

items.title: PlayStation 5 hardware sales dropped dramatically in the UK last month vs Xbox
items.description:
Current-generation Xbox hardware sales have been low in all major markets, registering its worst-ever year in the UK last year. Fortunes almost turned in May, however, a month when PlayStation suffered a big drop in its own sales.
